explore.title: Twelve palaces. One life.
explore.lead: Tap a palace to see how character, career, money and relationships connect in one chart.
explore.mobileHint: Tap the grid to open the other 8 palaces.
explore.cycles: Major periods cover ten years. Annual periods reveal each year’s fortune.

menh.name: Life
menh.title: Core self & temperament
menh.desc: The foundation of your character, your inner footing, and how you react when life veers off course. Every other palace is rooted here.

huynh.name: Siblings
huynh.title: Siblings & peers who know you
huynh.desc: The blood ties and the way people of your generation lift you up, walk beside you, or test your patience.

phuthe.name: Spouse
phuthe.title: Love & where you'll finally land
phuthe.desc: The kind of person who makes your heart want to stay, and the friction of real differences that takes listening and patience to outlast.

tutuc.name: Children
tutuc.title: Children & what continues after you
tutuc.desc: Your bond with the next generation, how you pass on love, and the hope you plant for the future.

taibach.name: Wealth
taibach.title: Money & the flow of fortune
taibach.desc: Do you earn through talent or opportunity? Why does money sometimes pour in like water, and other times slip right through your hands?

tatach.name: Health
tatach.title: Body & early warning signs
tatach.desc: Where your body quietly signals that it's time to rest. Looking after body and mind is always the root of everything else. Not medical advice.

thiendi.name: Travel
thiendi.title: Leaving home & meeting the world
thiendi.desc: Your bearing and resilience when you step outside your comfort zone: a new environment, a distant city, or journeys that shape your fate.

nobo.name: Friends
nobo.title: Friends, colleagues & partners
nobo.desc: Who stands shoulder to shoulder with you through hardship, and which relationships are quietly draining your energy?

quanloc.name: Career
quanloc.title: Career & standing in society
quanloc.desc: Where do you truly shine: steady structure, a position of authority, or the freedom to build your own venture?

dientrach.name: Property
dientrach.title: Land, home & where you settle
dientrach.desc: Your knack for building assets, the space that nourishes your spirit, and the feeling of truly belonging to a home.

phucduc.name: Fortune
phucduc.title: Roots of blessing & inner peace
phucduc.desc: The foundation of your inner life, your inner calm, and the quiet family lineage that shelters you through life's turns.

phumau.name: Parents
phumau.title: Parents & the home you grew up in
phumau.desc: The tie to the people who raised you, and the childhood lessons that follow you invisibly through your whole life.

needs.title: What is on your mind?

work.question: Should I quit and start over? Is this the stage to push hard, or to hold back and wait for the right time?

love.title: Relationships
love.question: Why do I keep running into the same pattern that hurts me? What kind of person is truly my safe harbor?
love.path: Spouse and Life palaces reveal attraction patterns and ways to resolve conflict.

decision.title: A decision ahead
decision.question: Standing at a fork in the road: sign this contract, accept this trip, or take a step back?
decision.path: The I Ching reads the timing of a specific situation: move forward or hold back.

kinhdich.name: I Ching

thansohoc.name: Numerology
thansohoc.desc: Your name, birth date and personal-year cycles reveal the rhythm of your life.

compare.title: Why choose Lá Số Việt?
compare.lead: An accurate chart. Readings with clear foundations. A lifelong companion.
compare.tableLabel: One key advantage and practical limits of each approach

strength.lsv: Accurate charts, deep personalisation and lifelong storage.
strength.web: Free lookup with instant charts and readings.
strength.thay: Face-to-face conversation and immediate personal attention.

own.lsv: Precise star placement by birth minute; readings focused on your concern.
own.web: Preset text gives people with the same stars the same reading.
own.ai: Depends on your prompt and can follow your biases.
own.thay: Depends on the reader’s experience, mood and personal judgement.

basis.lsv: Complete transparency, with each star and palace available for comparison.
basis.web: Unverified data and vague predictions create confusion.
basis.ai: Can place stars incorrectly while still answering confidently.
basis.thay: Oral traditions lack standardisation and are difficult to verify.

links.lsv: Tap one palace to see its trine and opposition relationships.
links.web: Fragmented palaces leave you to reconcile contradictory readings.
links.ai: Each question gives a fragment without a coherent overall picture.
links.thay: Spoken readings make the full twelve-palace picture difficult to see.

return.lsv: Absolute objectivity and consistency; subjective judgement is eliminated.
return.web: Lookup articles are inconsistent and contradict one another.
return.ai: Asking again can produce a contradictory answer.
return.thay: Different readers can interpret the same chart differently.

depth.lsv: Start free, then unlock the depth you need at a clear cost.
depth.web: Heavy advertising and rigid readings with unnecessary content.
depth.ai: Subscription costs leave you responsible for checking the answers.
depth.thay: High fees and difficulty scheduling follow-up questions.

faq.title: What else would you like to know?

q1.q: Can I start without my birth time?
q1.a: Yes. Choose “I don’t remember my birth time”. Add it later without losing the details you have entered.

q2.q: What can I see for free?
q2.a: Your complete twelve-palace chart, star meanings when you tap a palace, and two core insights. No card required.

q3.a: Lá unlocks deeper readings. Top-up packs show Lá and VND prices; payment uses VietQR. There are no hidden maintenance fees.

q4.q: Where can I find my chart again?
q4.a: Sign in and open your account to revisit your chart and unlocked readings on phone or computer.

q5.a: Anonymous data is deleted after 24 hours. Birth details, names and chart content are not sent to third-party tools.
